sources.label: Deloitte USDPT reserve examination for September 2026

reserveReview.rationale: Deloitte's September 30, 2026 11:59:59 PM UTC examination, signed October 26, 2026: reserves $22,505,889 against 22,400,125 redeemable USDPT on Solana. Schedule II reports $2,604,839 demand deposits at FDIC-insured depository institutions held directly (11.574033%; $2,354,839 uninsured) and $19,901,050 money market funds at NAV, split explicitly into CUSIP 09250C572 $17,952,847 (79.769553%; fund manager not named in report) and CUSIP 46655R119 $1,948,203 (8.656414%; JPMorgan OnChain Liquidity-Token Money Market Fund, linked to active jltxx-jpmorgan). Schedule III reports surplus $105,764 with no timing or temporary differences. Every slice carries the exact live anchorage-independent-assurance sourceKey and aligns in lockstep with proofOfReserves.latestReport and the live manifest.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Deloitte examination of the USDPT Reserve Report as of September 30, 2026
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: All positive reserve categories and values are identified. The report does not name the depository institutions or fund managers; CUSIP 46655R119 is matched to JPMorgan's primary JLTXX disclosure while CUSIP 09250C572 remains identified by CUSIP only.
